rules.source: AGENTS.md: Core thesis; README.md: Structural Guarantees

question.instructions: Does this change silently accept invalid content by bypassing existing typed schema or frontmatter validation or discarding its error diagnostics? Judge only demonstrated behavior in the supplied code; runtime validation is valid and must not be confused with compile-time proof.

criteria.violation: Changed production code bypasses an existing required-field, type, constraint or reference validation, or converts its error into accepted content without a diagnostic.
criteria.compliant: Changed code preserves the applicable validation and diagnostics, or adds typed validation without such a bypass.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The diff does not establish how the modified validation result is propagated or whether the apparent fallback intentionally implements optional-field policy.

rules.message: Preserve schema/frontmatter validation and actionable diagnostics instead of accepting invalid content silently.

rules.source: README.md: lattice check is strict validation without output writes

question.instructions: Does this change cause lattice check to publish generated site files or mutate the output cache or manifest? Distinguish build/serve/init/new paths from the check command; ordinary console diagnostics are allowed.

criteria.violation: The changed check-command execution path creates or writes generated site output, cache or manifest files.
criteria.compliant: The changed check path remains read-only with respect to generated output/cache/manifest, or writes are visibly limited to build/serve/init/new paths.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The supplied diff does not show whether a new filesystem write is reachable from check.

rules.message: Keep lattice check read-only: return diagnostics without publishing output, cache or manifest.

question.instructions: Does this change mutate generated output, cache or manifest before build preparation and destination preflight have succeeded? Preserve the existing preparation gate; do not demand atomic rollback after publication begins. Warning-only policies may remain unchanged.

criteria.violation: Changed code writes or creates generated output/cache/manifest before preparation errors and destination conflicts have been rejected, or publishes despite those errors.
criteria.compliant: Changed code keeps preparation in memory, rejects error diagnostics and predictable destination conflicts before writes, and writes cache/manifest after prepared files.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The diff lacks enough call-path or error-handling evidence to determine whether writes occur before or after successful preparation/preflight.

rules.message: Preserve the preparation/preflight gate and publish cache/manifest last; do not write output on validation or generation failure.
